title: Recall complete match arms
summary: Reconstruct four complete match arms from memory. Every state must be covered with its specified string literal; surrounding code remains hidden during Recall.

waiting.clue: Write the full match arm for Job’s Waiting variant returning the string "waiting"; omit the separating comma.

ready.clue: Write the full match arm for Job’s Ready variant returning the string "ready"; omit the separating comma.

running.clue: Write the full match arm for Job’s Running variant returning the string "running"; omit the separating comma.

failed.clue: Write the full match arm for Job’s Failed variant returning the string "failed"; omit the separating comma.
